# Legacy Office fixtures

Genuine OLE compound files (Word 97-2003 `.doc`, Excel 97-2003 `.xls`) from the
[Apache POI test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data), licensed under the
Apache License 2.0. They are kept as binaries so the tests exercise the real BIFF and Word binary
formats rather than renamed OOXML packages.

- [`innertable.doc`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/cba8f2740f45a6f5e906dc807f8d50c7da8b59a3/test-data/document/innertable.doc) checks nested table rows and cells.
- [`Lists.doc`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/cba8f2740f45a6f5e906dc807f8d50c7da8b59a3/test-data/document/Lists.doc) checks simple and multilevel numbered and bulleted lists.
